decisions.reason: Gives paste_image.png/paste_file.<ext> with (2),(3) before the extension, scanning until a free name; scopes the rename to the paste acquisition path only (drop/picker keep real names, regression-tested), grounded in fixture add()/validateItems. Unscored extension/display details correctly isolated in a separate section.

Names input.state.getSnapshot() occurrences as the authoritative occupied-name source, quotes the fixture's alive-subscription to explain records.delete firing on any momentary empty snapshot while an attachment stays live, and extends validateItems' in-batch Set with current-batch reservations.

Cites tags-api-response.txt (x-cache HIT, age 178, body predating v0.2.10/v0.2.11) and renderCurrentChip(tag) to explain the stale label; prescribes semantic fetched-vs-PLUGIN_VERSION comparison, showing the running version when remote <= running and never displaying an older tag as latest.

Concrete tests: repeated/separate pastes yield paste_image.png then paste_image(2).png; second paste still numbered after the record is retired (empty records cache, live occurrence); drop/picker names verbatim; stale older-tag mock never renders the older tag; newer v0.2.11 tag shows the update chip.

Requires keeping package.json version and hand-inlined PLUGIN_VERSION in sync (plus a sync gate / single-source constant), node --check on lib files, behavioral regressions, and explains users receive updates via reinstall through the install channel followed by browser reload, noting the chip does not install the artifact and there is no host-side update endpoint.
